message: The '{1}' {0} cannot be observed because it is not known to be constant: it is an instance method of a type that is not immutable, or it has a parameter of a type that is not immutable. If the {0} always returns the same value for the same arguments, mark it with [Constant] or call ConfigureObservability via a fabric.
title: Method is not supported for dependency analysis.
rationale: The message renders the attribute as [ConstantAttribute] (built with nameof), which is not how it is written in C#, and it does not say why the method is rejected; the report site in DependencyGraphBuilder.Visitor.ValidatePathElement reports it only for methods that return a value and are either instance methods of a non-immutable type or have a non-immutable parameter. The title mentions properties, but the only report site is for SymbolKind.Method.
codeChange: In DiagnosticDescriptors.cs, replace [{nameof(ConstantAttribute)}] with the literal [Constant].
